name: Nundar
description: A commerce theme for a technical catalogue: a specification finder, product pages built around a size table, landing pages for the applications a part is used in, collections by type, case studies and reference pages. HTML first: every page is complete without a script, and the two it declares only add to what is already there — filters for a table, calculators beside the tables of an engineering reference.

facets.label: Filterable attributes
facets.help: What a buyer filters the catalogue by, for example Head type, Thread, Material. Use the same names, in the same order, on every product: they become the columns of the specification finder.

sizes.label: Sizes
sizes.help: One row per size on offer: the SKU, then what distinguishes it, for example TI-SHC-M5-20 and 20 mm.

specs.label: Specifications
specs.help: The full specification, shown as a table on the product page.

collection.label: Collection
collection.help: Slug of the collection this product is listed in.

product.label: Product
product.help: Slug of the product this application note is about.

spec_highlights.label: Parameters that matter here
spec_highlights.help: The few specifications this application depends on.

sector.label: Sector
sector.help: The industry the work was done for, shown above the title.

product.label: Product
product.help: Slug of the product the case study used.

results.label: Results
results.help: The measured outcomes, each a short label and a figure.

faq.label: Questions and answers
faq.help: Each question with its answer. They are shown on the page and published as FAQ structured data.

calculators.label: Calculators
calculators.help: Shows interactive calculators above the text. "fasteners" is mass reduction, tightening torque and thread engagement; the text should give the same formulas, constants and tables, because that is what a visitor without the script sees.

home_description.label: Home page description, for search results and link previews
home_description.help: A sentence or two. Empty uses the site's tagline, which is also what follows the site's name in the home page's title.

hero_lede.label: Home page paragraph
hero_lede.default: Find a part by specification, or discuss a custom one with our team.

hero_badge.label: Caption on the home page picture

footer_note.label: Footer: a line under it, for example certifications held

privacy_href.label: Footer: link to the privacy policy

compliance_href.label: Footer: link to the compliance statement

clientScripts.purpose: Home page and catalogue only: filters and a search box above the specification table. The table is complete without it.
Engineering reference pages that ask for it only: three fastener calculators above a page that prints the same formulas, constants and tables of results.

Pages that show prices in more than one currency only: buttons that put each price's amount in another currency in its place, and keep the choice in this browser. The page is complete, in its language's own currency, without it.
